Our Approach

The Manicured Aesthetic That Defines These Streets

The Upper North Shore is Sydney's formal garden suburb heartland. Properties in Killara, Pymble, St Ives, and Wahroonga typically have large blocks with established formal hedges, mature landscaping, and a manicured street presence that's part of the neighbourhood's identity.

These properties need consistent, high-quality maintenance — not occasional attention. A hedge that's pristine in spring and shapeless by autumn isn't good enough here. Regular trimming, seasonal reductions at the right time, and a service that understands what a formal garden needs.

We offer monthly and fortnightly care plans specifically suited to Upper North Shore properties — so your garden maintains its standard year-round without you having to think about it.
